 ​

questions.question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options, pick the one that gives their correct order.**

A. To kill a whale, hunters used spears called harpoons.

B. Whale hunting is not easy.

C. These harpoons had very long and strong lines tied to them.

D. It was extremely difficult and risky before modern methods and machines began to be used.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'BDAC'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
• Sentence B in the given question is an **independent** general statement. It introduces the subject i.e.** 'Whale Hunting'**.
 
• Sentence D will be the next sentence because it is referring to '**Whale Hunting**' and how it was before modern methods and machines began to be used.
 
• Sentence A will be the next sentence because it expresses what new methods are being used to hunt a whale.
 
• Lastly, Sentence C will be used because it is connected to Sentence A. **'These'** mentioned in sentence C express the harpoons that have been mentioned in **sentence A**.
 
• Thus, the sequence becomes:
 
 
• B: Whale hunting is not easy.
 
• D: It was extremely difficult and risky before modern methods and machines began to be used.
 
• A: To kill a whale, hunters used spears called harpoons.
 
• C: These harpoons had very long and strong lines tied to them.
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 1.

 

Correct Sequence:__ *Whale hunting is not easy. It was extremely difficult and risky before modern methods and machines began to be used. To kill a whale, hunters used spears called harpoons. These harpoons had very long and strong lines tied to them.*

questions.question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment which contains a grammatical error.**

Until I was / still a little weak, / I decided to walk home / from the metro station.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Until I was**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is **grammatically incorrect.**
 
• Here, '**I was**' should be used instead of '**Until I was**'.
 
• Until is **a preposition and a conjunction**. Until is often shortened to till or 'til'. Till and 'til' are more informal and we don't usually use them in formal writing.
 
• In the given sentence '**until**' should not be used. **Until** as a preposition means '**up to (the time that)**'.
 
 
• *Example: We played chess **until** midnight.*
 
 
 
• The use of '**until**' and '**still**' in the same clause is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is **Option 2**.**
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *I was still a little weak, I decided to walk home from the metro station.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
 
• यहाँ '**Until I was**' के स्थान पर '**I was**' का प्रयोग होना चाहिए।
 
• **'Until'** एक **preposition** और एक conjunction** है। Till और til अधिक अनौपचारिक हैं और हम आमतौर पर औपचारिक लेखन में उनका उपयोग नहीं करते हैं।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में '**until**' का प्रयोग नहीं करना चाहिए। '**Until**' एक **preposition** है जिसका अर्थ है '(उस समय तक)'।
 
 
• *Example: We played chess until midnight.*​
 
 
 
• एक ही **clause** में '**until**' और '**still**' का प्रयोग व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत है।
 
• इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर **विकल्प 2** है।

questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

You can see vast valleys sloping into the distance.

options.text: Vast valleys can be seen sloping into the distance.
Vast valleys had been seen sloping into the distance.
Vast valleys are seen sloping into the distance.
Vast valleys will be seen sloping into the distance.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Vast valleys can be seen sloping into the distance.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'You'. 
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'Vast valleys'. 
 
• Since modal verb has been used in the active voice, therefore, the passive voice will follow the given structure:
 
 
• Active Voice - modal verb*(can) *+ V1 
 
• Passive Voice - modal verb*(can)* + be + V3
